reader.requirement: In an identifier (format 2: a data-name qualified by data-names and a cd-, file- or report-name), IN and OF are equivalent.
reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate; each grammar alternative is (OF | IN) with no predicate
reader.witnesses-cover: part: data-name and condition-name qualification; cd-name, file-name and report-name qualifiers are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: AAAA BBBB / CCCC DDDD / OK-R1-A OK-R1-B OK-R2-C OK-R2-D / 78 / 123 / CCCC / UNIQ / ZZZZZ / FFF12GGG34
probes.expected: every reference made unique by its qualifiers resolves to its own item: full and gapped chains, IN and OF mixed, record-name as data-name-1 and as qualifier, file-name qualifier, condition-names qualified by their conditional variable and its groups, subscripted qualified items, an unqualified unique name
DEST-COUNT OF CDA and DEST-COUNT IN OREC2 IN CDB resolve through format 1's cd-name qualifier
qualified RECORD KEY, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, RELATIVE KEY, FILE STATUS and READ KEY IS resolve; indexed dynamic and relative random; a failed READ gives 23
PAGE-COUNTER/LINE-COUNTER OF/IN report-name resolve (format 5, IN and OF equivalent)

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.5.3 SR1  the text is in SR1 (quoted: The words IN and OF are equivalent)

reader.notes: Same mechanism as SRL2.3: the qualification rule is (OF | IN) and only the word after it is read; probes mixing IN and OF through data-, file- and cd-name qualifiers resolve the same items.

refuter.evidence: Identifier qualification through a file-name (recq, ok2), a sort file (sdq), a report-name (rw6) and RENAMES operands (ren1), IN and OF mixed, resolves the same items. cite: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.5.3 SR1  the text is in SR1 (The words IN and OF are equivalent).
